description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Avatar Kyoshi.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi
uses.cardState: as Avatar Kyoshi without summoning sickness
